name: ag
description: Audit agents and evals; fix issues, compare evidence, and prepare delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and fix agents and evaluations
interface.longDescription: Audit all agents, one agent, local changes or existing evaluations. Fix described failures or eval gaps, compare against a baseline when available, independently review, and prepare local or PR delivery. Intelligence requests ask for approval unless explicitly set to full access.
defaultPrompt: Use ag:audit to audit this agent application and its existing evals.
Use ag:fix to fix this failure, validate the change and prepare delivery.
